The [[Phylon Transport/Legends|Phylon Transport]] '''Q7 tractor beam projector''', or simply '''Q7 projector''', was a model of [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]]. The unit was heavily favored by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. 

==Design==
Q7 tractor beam projectors were powerful enough to capture [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]],<ref name="EGWT" /> with an effective range of up to 120 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> The Q7, like other [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors, were large units requiring a crew of operators and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to function effectively.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
Ten Q7 projectors were installed on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. They were mounted on the ventral [[Hull/Legends|hull]] near the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] entrance, mounted on rotating towers.<ref name="EGWT" />

The Empire also installed them on their [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]], with the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] having 40 of them.
